_comment: CK's Pi Code Agent Harness configuration. Keys prefixed with '_' are documentation only; every other key must have a consumer in code (tests/test_governance.py::test_no_zombie_harness_config_keys).
_usableContextTokens: Usable context ceiling in tokens, NOT the engine's -c value. 0 = disabled (trust the declared contextWindow). This is machine-specific: measure it with `python scripts/calibrate-context.py` and let it write pi-config/harness-config.local.json (gitignored). Caps models.json contextWindow and derives settings.json compaction.
_perTurnPromptTokens: Fixed per-turn prompt (system prompt + tool schemas) in tokens. 0 = unknown. Machine-specific; calibrate-context.py measures it. It is a floor under the post-compaction context: ignoring it produces settings that compact every turn.
_enableHookAdvisories: ECC hook findings (quality-gate, format/typecheck, plan reminder) are appended to tool results so the model can read them. Set false if they pull a weak local model off course.
_enableEccGateGuard: ECC GateGuard is a fact-forcing gate, not a destructive-command filter: measured, it denies the FIRST bash command of every session whatever it is. It has never evaluated a command on this harness (the payload never reached it), so blocking is opt-in. When false the finding still reaches the model as advice.
_enableTaskShapeRouter: Multi-step requests that open with web_search/bash get a short routine naming planning-with-files and brainstorming. Measured baseline before this existed: multi-step-methodology 0/3. Advises, never blocks; on by default and fails open, unlike enableEccGateGuard which blocks and fails closed.
_enableDeepResearch: Off by default. Measured 2026-07-31: on one question deep_research spent 44 minutes across four child agents and returned nothing usable, while plain web_search + web_open answered it in 8 minutes with named sources. Five of the seven defects found in that validation round came from this bridge. The code and its 33 tests stay; set this to true to bring the tool and /deep-research back.
